Experience supporting the end-to-end deal lifecycle in enterprise technology, public sector, or another complex and regulated environment. Exceptional program-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple high-priority workstreams, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines. Strong systems and data orientation, including experience with CRM, reporting, workflow, and collaboration tools. Ability to move between detailed execution and systems-level problem solving without losing speed, accuracy, or accountability. Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority. Nice to Have Experience operating partner, alliance, channel, or co-sell programs in enterprise technology, cloud, or AI. You translate clearly among commercial, operational, legal, financial, and technical stakeholders and keep teams aligned. Are a systems thinker. You look for root causes, remove recurring friction, and use data and automation to improve how work gets done. Take ownership with low ego. You are calm under pressure, highly reliable, and willing to do whatever is needed to help the team and its customers succeed.
